mapper.insert: MERGE INTO FAVORITE_DISEASE F USING ( SELECT #{memberNo} AS MEMBER_NO, #{diseaseNo} AS DISEASE_NO FROM DUAL ) S ON (F.MEMBER_NO = S.MEMBER_NO AND F.DISEASE_NO = S.DISEASE_NO) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MEMBER_NO, DISEASE_NO, CREATED_AT) VALUES (S.MEMBER_NO, S.DISEASE_NO, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT D.DISEASE_NO, D.SOURCE_TYPE, D.SOURCE_CODE, D.DISEASE_NAME, D.ENGLISH_NAME, D.CATEGORY, D.DESCRIPTION, D.SYMPTOM_TEXT, D.SOURCE_URL, D.CREATED_AT, D.UPDATED_AT FROM FAVORITE_DISEASE F JOIN DISEASE D ON D.DISEASE_NO = F.DISEASE_NO WHERE F.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY F.CREATED_AT DESC, D.DISEASE_NO DESC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO FAVORITE_TRIAL F USING ( SELECT #{memberNo} AS MEMBER_NO, #{trialNo} AS TRIAL_NO FROM DUAL ) S ON (F.MEMBER_NO = S.MEMBER_NO AND F.TRIAL_NO = S.TRIAL_NO) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MEMBER_NO, TRIAL_NO, CREATED_AT) VALUES (S.MEMBER_NO, S.TRIAL_NO, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT T.TRIAL_NO, T.NCT_ID, T.BUSINESS_NO, T.SOURCE_TYPE, T.TITLE, T.OFFICIAL_TITLE, T.BRIEF_SUMMARY, T.PHASE, T.STUDY_TYPE, T.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, T.ELIGIBILITY_TEXT, T.SEX, T.MIN_AGE, T.MAX_AGE, T.ENROLLMENT_TARGET, T.ENROLLMENT_CURRENT, T.LEAD_SPONSOR, T.INSTITUTION_NAME, T.LOCATION_TEXT, T.CONTACT_NAME, T.CONTACT_PHONE, T.CONTACT_EMAIL, T.START_DATE_TEXT, T.COMPLETION_DATE_TEXT, T.REVIEW_STATUS, T.REJECT_REASON, T.VIEW_COUNT, T.CREATED_AT, T.UPDATED_AT FROM FAVORITE_TRIAL F JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = F.TRIAL_NO WHERE F.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY F.CREATED_AT DESC, T.TRIAL_NO DESC
